verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents a cap table product that imports historical transactions with attached documents, supports custom reports, and exposes cap table and transaction data via its API with incremental change sync. It also documents option and share-award granting with vesting, plus IFRS 2/US GAAP reporting that auditors could use. However, the evidence never mentions share classes, share certificates, or SAFEs, nor any investor-facing access to the cap table. missing for 10: explicit share class management, share certificates, SAFE/convertible instrument support, investor/auditor access to the live cap table, independent or hands-on corroboration.
